# Auto-generated by tools/gen_legend_master.py — 传奇控制台效果

ucm_legend_master_finalize_new_legend_effect = {
  scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target = {
    random_legend = {
      limit = {
        legend_owner = scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target
        NOR = { legend_quality = mythical }
      }
      change_legend_quality_effect = { VALUE = 100 }
      change_legend_quality_effect = { VALUE = 100 }
      set_variable = { name = legend_quality_progress value = 100 }
    }
    random_legend = {
      limit = { legend_owner = scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target }
      save_scope_as = ucm_new_legend
    }
    if = {
      limit = { exists = scope:ucm_new_legend }
      set_promoted_legend = scope:ucm_new_legend
    }
  }
}

ucm_legend_master_ensure_target_scope_effect = {
  ucm_cheat_menu_sync_target_effect = yes
  if = {
    limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target } }
    scope:actor = { save_scope_as = ucm_cheat_menu_target }
  }
}

ucm_legend_master_clear_owned_legends_effect = {
  ucm_legend_master_ensure_target_scope_effect = yes
  if = {
    limit = { exists = scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target }
    scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target = {
      save_scope_as = ucm_legend_clear_victim
      stop_promoting_legend = yes
      remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_fast_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_very_fast_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_instant_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_master_spread_cheat_modifier
      remove_character_modifier = legend_spread_debug_modifier
    }
    # CK3 1.20: there is no effect that deletes a legend (destroy_legend never existed), so this loop could never
    # finish and ran to the engine's iteration cap on every click. stop_promoting_legend above is what the game
    # offers: the legend stops spreading from this character.
    scope:actor = {
      send_interface_toast = {
        type = event_toast_effect_good
        title = ucm_legend_master_clear_toast_title
        desc = ucm_legend_master_clear_toast_desc
        left_icon = scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target
      }
    }
  }
}

ucm_legend_master_set_spread_speed_normal_effect = {
  scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target = {
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_fast_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_very_fast_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_instant_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_master_spread_cheat_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = legend_spread_debug_modifier
  }
}

ucm_legend_master_set_spread_speed_fast_effect = {
  scope:ucm_cheat_menu_target = {
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_fast_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_very_fast_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_instant_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_master_spread_cheat_modifier
    remove_character_modifier = legend_spread_debug_modifier
    add_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_fast_modifier
  }
}

    remove_character_modifier = ucm_legend_spread_speed_instant_modifier
